controls.label: Language
controls.purpose: Choose the language used throughout the workspace. Technical values and stored records are not translated.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: English message style
controls.purpose: Level 1 is direct and serious. Level 5 adds playful context. Actions, counts and errors retain the same facts.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Cantonese message style
controls.purpose: This controls Cantonese messages independently from English. Both style levels start at 5.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Show dialog decorations
controls.purpose: Add one relevant decorative symbol to dialog messages. Action labels and accessible names stay factual.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Narrate application messages
controls.purpose: Speak non-sensitive application status messages only after you enable this. Passwords and imported wording are never read aloud.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Narration language
controls.purpose: Both languages are spoken in order, never simultaneously. Missing voices are reported rather than substituted with an unrelated language.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: English voice
controls.purpose: Choose a voice reported by this computer. Automatic selection uses an available local English voice when possible.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Cantonese voice
controls.purpose: Choose a Hong Kong Cantonese voice reported by this computer. A saved but missing voice remains selected and its fallback is stated.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Speech rate
controls.purpose: Adjust the platform speech rate. One is normal delivery; unavailable speech synthesis remains explicitly unavailable.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Speech pitch
controls.purpose: Adjust the platform speech pitch between zero and two. One is the normal voice pitch.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Yield narration to a screen reader
controls.purpose: Suppress automatic application narration while using assistive speech. Browser rendering cannot reliably detect every screen reader, so this explicit choice is preserved.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Theme
controls.purpose: Apply a light or dark palette immediately. A matching schedule can temporarily override this base choice.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Density
controls.purpose: Change spacing without removing controls. Larger accessibility targets still take precedence.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Accent
controls.purpose: Choose the primary accent with the continuous native color selector or exact hexadecimal entry. Full multi-space color conversion remains incomplete.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Interface font
controls.purpose: Select a platform font family with a CJK-safe fallback. Installed-font enumeration and variable-axis editing are not yet available.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Interface text scale
controls.purpose: Scale interface typography immediately. Accessibility text scaling combines with this value.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Interface font weight
controls.purpose: Choose the standard interface weight. A font without the exact weight uses its platform-supported nearest weight.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Motion preference
controls.purpose: Reduced motion suppresses nonessential animation. The operating system preference is always respected, even when this choice follows the system.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Workspace mark
controls.purpose: Choose a built-in presentation mark. This never changes the executable, data directory or installed identity. Custom-image processing remains unavailable.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Show accessibility button
controls.purpose: Keep accessibility controls reachable in the persistent shell. Hiding requires a separate confirmation and does not reset preferences.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Accessibility text scale
controls.purpose: Increase readable interface text while preserving the base appearance scale. The layout must remain scrollable at larger values.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Higher contrast
controls.purpose: Strengthen text, panel boundaries and control outlines in the current theme. This changes the live workspace immediately.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Stronger keyboard focus
controls.purpose: Increase the visible focus outline for keyboard navigation. It does not move focus or change tab order.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Larger interaction targets
controls.purpose: Increase minimum control hit areas and spacing. Compact density never overrides the accessible target size.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Focus on the active workspace
controls.purpose: Dim inactive navigation while keeping it visible and immediately usable. Focused or hovered navigation returns to full emphasis.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Low stimulation
controls.purpose: Remove nonessential animation and suppress routine transient messages. Warnings and errors remain visible.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Show elapsed session time
controls.purpose: Display elapsed time in the workspace. This is a factual timer without a score, deadline or productivity judgement.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Keep one next action visible
controls.purpose: Show the action you enter below in the workspace so it survives navigation and restart. The application never chooses it for you.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Your next action
controls.purpose: Write a short action you want to keep in view. Empty text shows an honest prompt to choose an action. It is local personal content.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Offer an idle reminder
controls.purpose: Offer one dismissible reminder after the chosen idle interval. Not now suppresses further reminders for the stated snooze period.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Idle interval in minutes
controls.purpose: Count time since the last pointer or keyboard activity. The reminder says only what happened and never grades your work.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Reminder snooze in minutes
controls.purpose: Not now keeps the reminder quiet for this interval. The deadline persists across a reload.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Routine notification duration
controls.purpose: Routine messages auto-dismiss after this many seconds. Warnings and errors remain until explicitly dismissed.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Quiet hours
controls.purpose: During the local time window, suppress routine narration and transient messages. Errors remain available and all messages remain in the centre.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Quiet hours start
controls.purpose: Start quiet hours in this computer’s local timezone. A window may cross midnight.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Quiet hours end
controls.purpose: End quiet hours in local time. Equal start and end means quiet all day.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Command palette size
controls.purpose: Choose the presentation of the command palette opened with Ctrl+Shift+F. Its search state remains independent.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until a valid local presentation record explicitly stores this key.

controls.label: Action sounds
controls.purpose: Play short local tones after completed actions or failed operations. Quiet hours, low stimulation, narration and screen reader mode silence all tones.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until explicitly saved in native presentation preferences.

controls.label: Action sound volume
controls.purpose: Adjust action sounds from zero to 100 percent. Zero is silent. Sounds never replace visible results.
controls.sourceProvenance: Compiled default until explicitly saved in native presentation preferences.

workflows.label: Local schedule editor
workflows.purpose: Validate dates, times, weekdays, priority and setting value before appending a real rule.

workflows.label: Local schedule modification
workflows.purpose: Edit an existing stable rule without writing scheduled values into base preferences.

workflows.label: Schedule removal
workflows.purpose: Preview the rule and remove it through reversible local history.

workflows.label: Notification selection
workflows.purpose: Select current matches, ranges or inverse selection without changing unread state.

workflows.label: Notification dismissal
workflows.purpose: Dismiss selected messages, reporting count and preserving history.

workflows.label: Notification export
workflows.purpose: Export only the selected or filtered non-sensitive messages.

workflows.label: History date and action filter
workflows.purpose: Compose actual action categories, date bounds and text search.

workflows.label: Settings restore
workflows.purpose: Preview differences and record restore as a new revision.

workflows.label: Preference import
workflows.purpose: Validate the complete versioned file before changing any live setting.

workflows.label: Preference export
workflows.purpose: Choose a supported complete format, naming omitted private categories.

workflows.label: Preferences reset
workflows.purpose: Preview affected settings, preserve undo, and restore exact defaults.

workflows.label: Voice sample
workflows.purpose: Speak synthetic factual sample through the selected actual platform voice.

workflows.label: Speech stop and pause
workflows.purpose: Operate the actual speech queue, never simulated playback.

workflows.label: Hide accessibility entry
workflows.purpose: Require explicit confirmation with Cancel initially focused; retain preferences.

workflows.label: Restore accessibility entry
workflows.purpose: Restore immediately from reachable Settings without resetting preferences.
